whatsapp_troubleshooting_feedback.description: A single employee response to a versioned static troubleshooting guide offered during ticket intake.
whatsapp_troubleshooting_feedback.lifecycle: Recorded once as the conversation leaves the guidance step. The result survives dismissal of the draft and carries no contact, description or attachment fields.

draft_id.description: Opaque identifier of the draft whose guidance was rated or skipped.

guidance_id.description: Stable, versioned identifier of the instructions shown.

outcome.description: Employee choice to report resolution, ask for more help or skip the suggestion.

recorded_at.description: Instant at which the conversation accepted the response.

objects.whatsapp_troubleshooting_feedback_pkey: Keeps one guidance outcome per draft across retries.
objects.whatsapp_troubleshooting_feedback_outcom: Supports aggregate reporting by guide and outcome.

enums.WhatsAppTroubleshootingOutcome: Employee response to optional guidance. RESOLVED closes the draft. NOT_RESOLVED and SKIPPED keep the draft for review.
